summary: Backend testing for VELVENYA waitlist API completed. All 11 pytest tests passed against external preview URL covering root endpoint, waitlist create (valid/invalid/duplicate/case-insensitive), list (with _id exclusion and recency ordering), and count endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — consider migrating to FastAPI lifespan handlers.
No rate limiting on POST /api/waitlist — public endpoint open to abuse/email spam. Consider IP-based throttling.
No index on 'email' field in MongoDB collection — duplicate-check find_one will degrade as the collection grows. Recommend creating a unique index on email.

datetime is stored as ISO string but the Pydantic model declares it as datetime; conversion is done manually in two places (duplicate-fetch and list). Centralize parsing or store as native BSON datetime to simplify code.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — combination is rejected by browsers and is a security smell. Set explicit origins in env.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_*@example.com entries were inserted into the 'waitlist' collection during test runs (idempotency, ordering, count tests). They are harmless but not cleaned up (no DELETE endpoint exists).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_waitlist.py exercise all 4 waitlist endpoints. Tests insert TEST_ prefixed entries; no delete endpoint exists to clean them. Re-run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://velvenya-coming-soon.preview.emergentagent.com pytest /app/backend/tests/test_waitlist.py -v
